title: Tideglass Transit
generation_prompt: Original all-ages melodic house instrumental for a one-or-two-key electronic rhythm game, around 122 BPM in clear four-beat bars. Develop the phrase through changing chord inversions and a second syncopated bell-like counterline, with distinct kick, clap and pluck onsets suitable for rhythm charts. Near the midpoint open a quieter section with a new descending answer melody and sparse percussion, then rebuild into a brighter final section that transforms the first phrase rather than repeating an entire half. Keep one evolving 128-second stereo composition with dynamic breathing room, no harsh distortion, vocals, speech, sampled recordings or known melody.

No people, vehicles, water, text, letters, numbers, logo or imitation of any existing game.
